name: javascript-format
description: Formats JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX and JSON with Biome once per batch of tool calls and at git pre-commit, and reports Biome lint findings at commit, only where a biome.json governs the file; formatting and linting are separate, no lint fix runs, and hooks never run an ecosystem record's command.

javascript_format_enabled.title: Format JS/TS/JSON after edits
javascript_format_enabled.description: After each batch of tool calls, run the resolved format command over the JavaScript, TypeScript and JSON files it wrote

javascript_format_lint_gitignored.title: Act on files git ignores
javascript_format_lint_gitignored.description: By default the hook leaves a file the repository gitignores alone: it is not rewritten or linted, since a rewrite of an ignored file has no git checkout to undo it. Set true to act on gitignored files too. A tracked file that matches an ignore pattern is always in scope.

javascript_format_end_of_turn.title: Check JS/TS/JSON in uncommitted changes at turn end
javascript_format_end_of_turn.description: At the end of each turn, run the pre-commit lint entry over the lines changed since the last commit and hand any findings back so they are fixed before the turn ends, at most once per turn. Nothing is rewritten. Off by default.
